body: Qualcomm, meanwhile, references several points in the specification where the '822 Patent teaches that the metric of forward link geometry may be determined "as a function of observed pilot signals, noise, and/or traffic on data channels." JA70 at 2:35-37. See also JA72 at 6:61-7:3 ("For example, Region R1 defines a Region having [*63] CQI values corresponding to power and/or noise levels greater than P1."). . See Cipher Pharms. Inc. v. Actavis Labs. FL, Inc., 99 F. Supp. 3d 508, 518 (D.N.J. 2015) ("and/or" is a function word to indicate that "two words or expressions are to be taken together or individually.").
